unresolved.first_comment: [P2] Apply TLS settings to Sentinel discovery connections Please pass the TLS setting into `sentinel_kwargs` in both `get_redis()` and `get_redis_sync()`. `redis_sentinel_ssl` is documented as enabling TLS to Sentinel, but it is only applied to `master_for()`, so the discovery clients remain plain `Connection` instances. Against a real TLS-only Sentinel, both clients fail discovery with `MasterNotFoundError` after the connection is reset; redis-py Sentinel clients configured with `ssl=True` in `sentinel_kwargs` discover the same master successfully. Enabling TLS only for the discovered master cannot establish the Sentinel connection.
